anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential over-utilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles or opportunities, suggesting it may not be functioning as expected.
Trading system shows no active or profitable trades, which is unusual for a trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review AI system configurations and logs to ensure it is properly trained and capable of generating opportunities.
Evaluate current trading strategies for effectiveness and adjust parameters or strategies to improve trading outcomes.

recommendations.action: Conduct a detailed analysis of CPU usage to identify and address any processes causing high load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting trading operations.
